headline: Zoning requests for a pet grooming business at 151 Canal Street and home projects at several addresses.
summary: The agenda includes a dog-grooming kennel at 151 Canal Street and several home projects, including a fence, a porch, and a garage conversion. The 111 Mason Street request was asked to be moved to December 16, 2026.
items: 111 Mason Street: two detached accessory dwelling units, with variances and a special permit (continuance requested to December 16, 2026)
8 1/2 Rear Allen Street: 1.5-story addition and landing on a single-family house, with a variance
19 Bertuccio Avenue: 18-foot elevated deck and 9.5-foot staircase, with a variance
31 Raymond Road: 17.5-foot covered porch and front staircase, with a variance
151 Canal Street: dog-grooming-only kennel business, with a special permit and variances
76-78 Endicott Street U2: seven-foot fence along Hathorne Street, with variances
6 Manning Street: convert detached garage to an accessory dwelling unit, with a finding
Discussion and vote on the 2027 Zoning Board of Appeals meeting schedule

NOTICE OF MEETING 
 
Notice is given for a Zoning Board of Appeals open public meeting held remotely on 
November 18, 2026, at 6:30pm. The City is authorized to conduct remote meetings 
of its public bodies through special acts of the Massachusetts State Legislature. 
   
Nina Vyedin, Chair   
 
Important Announcement:    
Every effort will be made to ensure that the public can adequately access the proceedings 
in real time, via technological means. If we are unable to do so on matters not requiring 
a public hearing, we will post on the City of Salem’s website an audio or video recording, 
transcript, or other comprehensive record of proceedings after the meeting. 
 
Individuals may participate remotely using a remote participation platform called Zoom. 
Members of the public can access the remote meeting in any of the following ways:    
   
Attending the Virtual Public Meeting:    
• Go to Website link: 
https://us02web.zoom.us/j/83427530365?pwd=GqYiOJHxKonVjQUFuWQgPfRiqV4Mh2.1
or go to the website link https://zoom.us/join and enter the meeting ID #834 
2753 0365 followed by meeting password 011324 if directed to do so on 
screen.     
• Dial toll-free phone number 877-853-5257. When prompted enter meeting ID 
#834 2753 0365 followed by meeting password 011324 if directed. Those 
calling in will not have access to the direct video feed of the meeting but can 
follow along with the project materials available for 
download at https://www.salemma.gov/877/Zoning-Board-of-Appeals.   
• Watch the meeting live on Salem Access Television Chanel 22.    
• Project materials are available for download at https://tinyurl.com/SalemZBA.  
 
Providing Public Comment Before the Meeting:    
Members of the public can email their comment s before the start of the meeting 
to zoningboardcomments@salem.com.         
 
Providing Public Comment During the Meeting:     
Members of the public attending this meeting virtually will be allowed to make comments 
when the Chair opens the hearing for public comments. Members of the public will be

We encourage members of the public to install and familiarize themselves with Zoom

If you plan on providing public comments and are logging into this meeting via the Zoom 
application, please test your speakers and microphone ahead of time. If we have trouble 
hearing you when you speak, we will move on to the next person and try to return to you 
later in the list. If this happens, we recommend that you call the toll -free number to 
access the meeting and provide your comment.

MEETING AGENDA   
   
I. ROLL CALL  
 
II. CONTINUANCES 
 
1. Location: 111 Mason Street (R2 Zoning District) 
Applicant: Marc Tranos 
Description: The petition of MARC TRANOS at 111 MASON STREET (Map 16, Lot 
0363) (R2 Zoning District) for Variances per Section 3.2.8(4.l), 3.2.8(4.m), and 
3.2.8(4.q) Accessory Dwelling Units (ADUs), and Section 5.1.5(6.c) Design, and a 
Special Permit per Section 3.2.8(4.q) ADUs  of the Salem Zoning Ordinance to 
construct two detached ADUs on a nonconforming lot, including one protected use 
ADU and one additional ADU by Special Permit. The proposal includes two 19.5 -
foot-tall detached ADUs with reduced side and building -to-primary-dwelling 
setbacks, and two 18-foot-wide curb cuts where a total curb cut width of 20 feet 
is permitted. 
 
The Applicant requested to continue this item to December 16, 2026. 
 
2. Location: 8 1/2 Rear Allen Street (R2 Zoning District) 
Applicant: Lacey Smith 
Description: The petition of LACEY SMITH at 8 1/2 REAR ALLEN STREET (Map 
41, Lot 0159) (R2 Zoning District; Coastal Resiliency Overlay District) for a Variance 
per Section 4.1.1 Dimensional Requirements  of the Salem Zoning Ordinance to 
extend a nonconforming single-family house by constructing a 1.5 -story addition 
and landing to the house’s north and east sides. The proposed addition would have 
a five-foot side (north) setback and be located inside the required side (south) 
setback, while the proposed landing’s roof would extend five feet from the addition 
towards the side (north) property line. The property’s lot coverage would increase 
from 23% to 42% where 35% is permitted. 
 
3. Location: 19 Bertuccio Avenue (R1 Zoning District) 
Applicant: Jordan Sidebottom 
Description: The petition of JORDAN SIDEBOTTOM at 19 BERTUCCIO AVENUE 
(Map 24, Lot 0098) (R1 Zoning District) for a Variance per Section 4.1.1 
Dimensional Requirements of the Salem Zoning Ordinance to construct an 
approximately eighteen-foot-tall elevated deck and a 9.5-foot-tall staircase to the 
front of a nonconforming single -family house. The proposed deck and staircase 
would have an approximate six-foot side setback and a four-foot front setback. 
 
III. REGULAR AGENDA

4. Location: 31 Raymond Road (R1 Zoning District) 
Applicant: Victoria Dela Cruz 
Description: The petition of VICTORIA DELA CRUZ at 31 RAYMOND ROAD (Map 
32, Lot 0151) (R1 Zoning District) for a Variance per Section 4.1.1 Dimensional 
Requirements of the Salem Zoning Ordinance to construct a 17.5-foot-tall covered 
porch to the front of a single -family house, approximately eleven feet from the 
front property line where fifteen feet is permitted, with a front staircase extending 
five feet from the porch. 
 
5. Location: 151 Canal Street (B4 Zoning District; Entrance Corridor Overlay District; 
Flood Hazard Overlay District) 
Applicant: Cassandra Pappalardo d/b/a Bellatrix Pet Spa 
Description: The petition of CASSANDRA PAPPALARDO d/b/a BELLATRIX PET 
SPA at 151 CANAL STREET (Map 33, Lot 0036) (B4 Zoning District; Entrance 
Corridor Overlay District; Flood Hazard Overlay District) for a Special Permit per 
Section 3.1.2 Special Permit  and Variances per Section 5.1.5(6.c) Design and 
Section 10.0 Definitions of the Salem Zoning Ordinance to operate a dog -
grooming-only kennel business (Section 3.1.2) with 34-foot and 90-foot entrance 
and exit drives along Canal Street and Hersey Street, where a total curb cut width 
of 30 feet is permitted (Section 5.1.5(6.c)), and a total lot area of 9,480 square 
feet where five acres are permitted (Section 10.0). 
 
6. Location: 76-78 Endicott Street U2 (R2 Zoning District) 
Applicant: Christopher B. Ingersoll 
Description: The petition of CHRISTOPHER B. INGERSOLL at 76 -78 ENDICOTT 
STREET U2 (Map 25, Lot 0453) (R2 Zoning District) for Variances per Section 4.1.1 
Dimensional Requirements and Section 6.8 Visibility at Intersections of the Salem 
Zoning Ordinance to construct a seven-foot-tall fence on portions of the property’s 
side and rear yard along Hathorne Street. The proposed fence would be seven feet 
tall, where six feet are permitted, and be located twenty feet from the t riangular 
area formed by the intersection of street lines, where twenty -five feet are 
permitted. 
 
7. Location: 6 Manning Street (R2 Zoning District) 
Applicant: Matt & Beth Anne Cornell 
Description: The petition of MATT & BETH ANNE CORNELL at 6 MANNING 
STREET (Map 27, Lot 0370) (R2 Zoning District) for a finding per Section 3.2.8(4.k) 
Accessory Dwelling Units (ADUs) of the Salem Zoning Ordinance to convert an 
existing detached garage to an ADU on a nonconforming lot. The proposed ADU 
would be three feet from the side property line with a front addition and a side 
roof overhang.
